profile.headline: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience building modern web applications, cloud-native services, and local AI integrations using React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Python.

highlights: Architected and deployed microservices handling 2M+ daily active requests with 99.98% uptime.
Led transition to Vite and React 19, reducing frontend build times by 65%.
Implemented local AI agent pipelines for internal developer tooling using Ollama and Llama 3.
Developed customer-facing dashboard and automated analytics pipeline with TypeScript and PostgreSQL.
Engineered responsive web client and RESTful API endpoints for multi-tenant SaaS application.

projects.title: RolePilot Local Agent
projects.description: Privacy-first local job application agent powered by Ollama LLM and SQLite.
outcomes: Integrated offline LLM inference with zero data leakage.

achievements: Author of open-source local LLM TypeScript SDK

customAnswers.why_company: I am deeply inspired by your team's mission to build user-focused, privacy-respecting products. My background in high-performance web applications matches your current engineering roadmap.
customAnswers.greatest_achievement: Designing an automated offline-first agent system that saved our engineering team 15+ hours per week in routine workflows.
